name: hl-report-tooling
description: Tests and live-corpus verification for the report ATT&CK coverage and glossary modules.

scripts.verify: node verify-corpus.js && node check-wire.js && node check-ioc-index.js && node check-detection-attack.js && node check-tags.js && node check-companions.js
scripts.wire:pull: git fetch origin +refs/heads/wire-data:refs/remotes/origin/wire-data && git show origin/wire-data:wire.yml > ../../_data/wire.yml && grep -m1 generated_at ../../_data/wire.yml
scripts.verify:browser: HL_SITE_DIR=${HL_SITE_DIR:-../../_site} node check-browser-wire.js; w=$?; node check-browser-report.js; r=$?; node check-browser-downloads.js; d=$?; [ $w -eq 1 ] || [ $r -eq 1 ] || [ $d -eq 1 ] && exit 1; [ $w -ne 0 ] || [ $r -ne 0 ] || [ $d -ne 0 ] && exit 2; exit 0
